cases.prompt: Show all students
cases.gold_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, email, department_id, cgpa, enrollment_year FROM students;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, email, department_id, cgpa, enrollment_year FROM students;

cases.prompt: Show all students with CGPA greater than 8
cases.gold_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, cgpa FROM students WHERE cgpa > 8.0 ORDER BY cgpa DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, email, cgpa, enrollment_year
FROM students
WHERE cgpa > 8.0
ORDER BY cgpa DESC;

cases.prompt: List all departments
cases.gold_sql: SELECT department_id, department_name, building, budget FROM departments;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT department_id, department_name, building, budget FROM departments;

cases.prompt: Show students enrolled in 2023
cases.gold_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, cgpa, enrollment_year FROM students WHERE enrollment_year = 2023;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, email, department_id, cgpa, enrollment_year FROM students WHERE enrollment_year = 2023;

cases.prompt: Average CGPA per department
cases.gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(s.cgpa)::numeric, 2) AS avg_cgpa FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY avg_cgpa DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(s.cgpa), 2) AS average_cgpa 
FROM students s 
JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id 
GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;

cases.prompt: List all courses with their instructor names
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.course_code, c.course_title, i.name AS instructor_name FROM courses c JOIN instructors i ON c.instructor_id = i.instructor_id;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT c.course_title, c.course_code, i.name AS instructor_name FROM courses c LEFT JOIN instructors i ON c.instructor_id = i.instructor_id;

cases.prompt: Total number of students per department
cases.gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS student_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN students s ON d.department_id = s.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY student_count DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS total_students 
FROM departments d 
LEFT JOIN students s ON d.department_id = s.department_id 
GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;

cases.prompt: Show students with CGPA between 8 and 9.5
cases.gold_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, cgpa FROM students WHERE cgpa BETWEEN 8.0 AND 9.5 ORDER BY cgpa DESC;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name, cgpa FROM students WHERE cgpa BETWEEN 8.0 AND 9.5 ORDER BY cgpa DESC;

cases.prompt: Show top 3 students by CGPA with their department name
cases.gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.cgpa, d.department_name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY s.cgpa DESC LIMIT 3;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.cgpa, d.department_name 
FROM students s 
JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id 
ORDER BY s.cgpa DESC 
LIMIT 3;

cases.prompt: Total enrollments per course sorted by most popular
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.course_title, COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS total_enrollments FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id GROUP BY c.course_title ORDER BY total_enrollments DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT c.course_code, c.course_title, COUNT(e.enrollment_id) AS total_enrollments 
FROM courses c 
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON c.course_id = e.course_id 
GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_code, c.course_title 
ORDER BY total_enrollments DESC;

cases.prompt: List all products
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, category, unit_price, stock_quantity FROM products;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, category, unit_price, stock_quantity FROM products;

cases.prompt: Show all orders
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount, status FROM orders;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, total_amount, status FROM orders;

cases.prompt: List products with low stock under 50 units
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, category, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 50 ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT product_name, category, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 50 ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC;

cases.prompt: Top 5 products by total sales revenue
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit) AS total_revenue 
FROM products p 
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id 
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 5;

cases.prompt: Show completed orders with customer names
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, o.order_date, o.total_amount 
FROM orders o 
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id 
WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.prompt: Total revenue per product category
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit) AS category_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY category_revenue DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price_per_unit) AS total_revenue 
FROM products p 
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id 
GROUP BY p.category 
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

cases.prompt: List all customers from India
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, city, country FROM customers WHERE country = 'India';

cases.prompt: Show customer name with their total number of orders and total amount spent
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_name, 
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, 
    SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent 
FROM customers c 
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id 
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;

cases.prompt: Average order value per customer country
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS avg_order_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_name, 
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, 
    SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent 
FROM customers c 
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id 
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;

cases.prompt: Show orders placed in February 2024 with customer details
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-03-01';
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount, c.customer_name, c.city, c.country 
FROM orders o 
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id 
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29';

cases.prompt: List all employees
cases.gold_sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_name, job_title, dept_id, hire_date, salary FROM employees;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT emp_id, emp_name, job_title, dept_id, hire_date, salary FROM employees;

cases.prompt: Show all corporate departments with their locations
cases.gold_sql: SELECT dept_id, dept_name, location FROM corp_departments;
cases.generated_sql: SELECT dept_name, location FROM corp_departments;

cases.prompt: Average salary per corporate department
cases.gold_sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT cd.dept_name, ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS avg_salary 
FROM corp_departments cd 
JOIN employees e ON cd.dept_id = e.dept_id 
GROUP BY cd.dept_id, cd.dept_name;

cases.prompt: Show employees with salary greater than 100000
cases.gold_sql: SELECT emp_name, job_title, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > 100000 ORDER BY salary DESC;

cases.prompt: List employees hired after 2020 with their department name
cases.gold_sql: SELECT e.emp_name, e.job_title, cd.dept_name, e.hire_date FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id WHERE e.hire_date > '2020-01-01' ORDER BY e.hire_date ASC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT e.emp_name, e.hire_date, cd.dept_name 
FROM employees e 
JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id 
WHERE e.hire_date > '2020-12-31';

cases.prompt: Total headcount per corporate department
cases.gold_sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS headcount FROM corp_departments cd LEFT JOIN employees e ON cd.dept_id = e.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_name ORDER BY headcount DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT cd.dept_name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS headcount
FROM corp_departments cd
LEFT JOIN employees e ON cd.dept_id = e.dept_id
GROUP BY cd.dept_id, cd.dept_name;

cases.prompt: Show the highest paid employee in each department
cases.gold_sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, e.emp_name, e.salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id WHERE e.salary = (SELECT MAX(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.dept_id = e.dept_id);
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT e.emp_name, cd.dept_name, e.salary 
FROM employees e 
JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id 
WHERE (e.dept_id, e.salary) IN (
    SELECT dept_id, MAX(salary) 
    FROM employees 
    GROUP BY dept_id
);

cases.prompt: Total salary expenditure per department
cases.gold_sql: SELECT cd.dept_name, SUM(e.salary) AS total_salary FROM employees e JOIN corp_departments cd ON e.dept_id = cd.dept_id GROUP BY cd.dept_name ORDER BY total_salary DESC;
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT d.department_name, SUM(i.salary) AS total_salary_expenditure
FROM instructors i
JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.department_id
GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name;

cases.prompt: Show instructor names and their department budget
cases.gold_sql: SELECT i.name AS instructor_name, d.department_name, d.budget FROM instructors i JOIN departments d ON i.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY d.budget DESC;

cases.prompt: Show students who got grade A or A+ in any course
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id WHERE e.grade IN ('A', 'A+');
cases.generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name, e.grade 
FROM students s 
JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id 
WHERE e.grade IN ('A', 'A+');
